name: Hunting for Missing Options
effect: On every prompt, including poems, greetings and personal questions, the altered model claims the question doesn't match some options that aren't there, then tries to rebuild a multiple-choice list. It loops on placeholders like '[Option A]
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
